# Cellex 4A

```{python}
#| label: import_libraries
import pandas as pd
from pathlib import Path
import lecilab_behavior_analysis.utils as utils
import lecilab_behavior_analysis.figure_maker as fm
import datetime
from IPython.display import clear_output
clear_output(wait=True)
```

```{python}
#| label: define_variables
max_date = pd.to_datetime("2026-02-27") + pd.Timedelta(days=1)
project = "COT_cannula_data"
setup_name = "village02"
```

```{python}
#| label: load_temperature_and_humidity_data
local_path = Path(utils.get_outpath()) / Path(project) / Path(setup_name)
temperatures_df = pd.read_csv(local_path / Path("temperatures.csv"), sep=";")
temperatures_df.date = pd.to_datetime(temperatures_df.date)
```

```{python}
#| label: plot
fig = fm.make_temperature_humidity_figure(temperatures_df[temperatures_df["date"] >= (max_date - pd.Timedelta(days=7))])
fig
```
